end.summary:
Defined food miles as the distance food travels from farm to home.
Compared local and far-travelled foods using distance, fuel use, pollution, freshness, and refrigeration.
Correctly added food-mile distances: 30+12=42 km and 220+90=310 km.
Suggested local-market buying, growing food at school, and using a nearby shop to reduce food miles.
Teach-back was not passed; ideas for reducing food miles were not yet explained with their limits.
end.parentNote: Asha practised tracing food journeys from farm to home and comparing foods by travel distance. Rohan used the route stages correctly, explained that longer journeys can use more fuel, and connected refrigerated transport with extra cost, petrol, and electricity. They mixed up whether nearby shops automatically mean food is local, and this was not clearly corrected by the end. At home, ask them to draw one food journey and label where travel could be shortened and what limitation that choice might have.

ज़्यादा होंगे। असम बहुत दूर है, तो चाय को ट्रक में बहुत दिन लगते होंगे।

Sahi, Assam se Jaipur door hai, isliye chai ki safar-doori zyada hai. Truck mein kitne din lage, yeh humein abhi pata nahi. Milaan wala khel nahi aaya, toh bolkar khelte hain: Himachal ka seb Chennai aata hai, aur kela Chennai ke paas ugta hai. Chennai ki mandi tak pahunchne mein kiske safar mein zyada indhan laga hoga?
सेब में ज़्यादा लगा होगा, बिल्कुल। हिमाचल से चेन्नई बहुत दूर है ना, ट्रक को बहुत पेट्रोल खत्म करना पड़ता है। केला तो बस पास ही है।

Aapne seb ka lamba safar aur truck ke indhan ki baat ki. Ab do gajar ke safar sochiye: ek assi kilometer, doosra do sau tees kilometer. Dono ki gaadiyan milti-julti hon, toh kis delivery mein indhan kam lagne ki sambhavna hai, aur kyon?
80 km wali farm se kam lagega na, kyuki road chhoti hai. 230 km to bahut door hai, usme van ko zyada petrol peena padega.
Sahi, assi kilometer wali van ko kam indhan lagne ki sambhavna hai. Ab sochiye: door se garam safar karke aati strawberry ko taaza rakhne ke liye kya chahiye, aur usse kya badhta hai?
स्ट्रॉबेरी को ठंडा रखना पड़ेगा ना, फ्रिज वाली गाड़ी चाहिए। इससे खर्चा बढ़ जाता है, पेट्रोल और बिजली का।

Strawberry ko thanda rakhne ke liye thandi gaadi chahiye, aur usmein bijli ya indhan lagta hai. Isse hawa ka pradushan bhi badh sakta hai. Ab May mein paas ki mandi se aaye aam aur December mein door se aaye aam ki tulna kijiye: kaunse aam sthaniya aur mausami hain, aur unse kya fayde ho sakte hain?
मई वाले आम लोकल हैं। मंडी पास है, तो सफर छोटा है, इसलिए वो मौसमी हैं। उनमें ज़्यादा मीठापन होता है और वो सस्ते भी होते हैं। दिसंबर वाले आम बाहर से मंगाए गए हैं, तो वो लोकल नहीं।

May wale aam mausami hain, aur December wale aam door se aaye hain. Par paas ki mandi se kharidne ka matlab yeh pakka nahi ki aam paas hi uge; mithaas aur daam bhi pakke nahi hote. Ab tamatar khet se bazaar tak tees kilometer, phir school tak baarah kilometer aaye. Unka poora safar kitna hua?
42 kilometer. 30 plus 12 toh 42 hote hain na.

Haan, tamatar ka poora safar bayalis kilometer hai; aapne dono hisse jode. Ab aloo Punjab mein uge, Haryana mein pack hue, aur Delhi ki dukaan pahunche. Agar pehla safar do sau bees kilometer aur doosra nabbe kilometer tha, toh khane ki safar-doori kitni hui?
310 km. 220 plus 90 kiya toh 310 hota hai.

Sahi, aloo ka poora safar teen sau das kilometer hai. Aapne ugaane ki jagah se packing aur phir dukaan tak dono dooriyan jodi. Ab school ke dopahar ke khaane ki safar-doori kam karne ke teen tareeke kya ho sakte hain?
देखो ना, मैंने तो बोल दिए ना ideas! पास की मंडी से लाओ... और स्कूल में ही उगा लो... और... और... पास की दुकान से लो, बस। तीन हो गए ना?

Haan, aapne teen tareeke bataye: paas ki mandi, school mein ugana, aur paas ki dukaan. Bas dukaan se yeh bhi poochhna hoga ki khaana uga kahan tha. Sardiyon mein school ko phal bhi dena hai; kya hamesha sirf paas ka phal lena chahiye, ya jab mile tab paas ka mausami phal lena chahiye?
